verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a public interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents an API, an API reference, or runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec at common paths all returned 404, and the only documented integration is a first-party Gusto sync, which is not a developer API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
